此工作流程使用两个 K 采样器当使用 SDXL 或 SD 1.5 型号时，而不是仅使用一个。这意味着 Pony、Illustrious 或任何基于 SDXL 构建的东西都可以很好地工作。

为什么使用这个而不是 1Sampler？因为它能清理掉一些小事情。一个采样器可能会留下小故障或奇怪的位，但运行第二个采样器通常可以修复它们，而不会太大改变主图像。您将获得更清晰、更清晰的结果。

如果您关心这些额外的细节，那么这是完全值得的。不需要那个更长，并且它可以在任何具有 8GB VRAM 或更多内存的机器上正常运行。

对我来说，第一次通过大约需要 7 秒，第二次大约需要 17 秒，但是，这取决于你的分辨率。

o.en:
This workflow usestwo KSamplersinstead of just one when working with SDXL or SD 1.5 models. That means stuff like Pony, Illustrious, or anything built on SDXL will work great.

Why use this instead of 1Sampler?Because it cleans up the little things. One sampler can leave behind small glitches or weird bits, but running a second one usually fixes them without changing the main image much. You get a cleaner, sharper result.

If you care about those extra details, it’s totally worth it. It doesn’t takethatmuch longer, and it runs fine on any machine with 8GB VRAM or more.

For me, the first pass took about 7 seconds, and the second one around 17, but yeah, that depends on your resolution.
